name: topic-scoping-benchmark
description: Dataset for evaluating how well models can identify and scope topics—i.e., determine topic boundaries, relevance, and appropriate level of specificity. Tasks typically require understanding a prompt and producing or selecting the appropriate topic scope or refinement. Useful for research on topic modeling, summarization pre-processing, and conversational focus control.
reputation: A small and specialized dataset hosted on Hugging Face with modest usage in niche topic-scoping research.
